messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Oversight  

Hi Alex,  

I’m sorry for missing the deadline on the project report yesterday. It was inconsiderate of me and caused extra work for you. I value our teamwork and will set reminders to avoid this in the future.  

Please let me know if there’s anything else I can do to make things right.  

Thank you for your understanding.  

Best regards,  
Jordan  

PLAN:  
Identify recipient’s name and context.  
Choose a sincere, brief tone.  
Draft the apology with specific acknowledgment and corrective action.  
Review for clarity and politeness before sending.
